```{r}
normalize_tcga_id <- function(x) {
  substr(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    ),
    1,
    16
  )
}


assert_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (
    !file.exists(
      file
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


read_count_matrix <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name
) {
  assert_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      " count matrix"
    )
  )

  counts <- as.matrix(
    read.csv(
      file,
      row.names = 1,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  suppressWarnings(
    storage.mode(
      counts
    ) <-
      "numeric"
  )

  if (
    anyNA(
      counts
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": count matrix contains NA/non-numeric values."
    )
  }

  if (
    any(
      counts < 0
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": count matrix contains negative values."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyDuplicated(
      rownames(
        counts
      )
    )
  ) {
    message(
      dataset_name,
      ": collapsing duplicated gene rows by summing counts."
    )

    counts <- rowsum(
      counts,
      group =
        rownames(
          counts
        ),
      reorder =
        FALSE
    )
  }

  colnames(
    counts
  ) <-
    normalize_tcga_id(
      colnames(
        counts
      )
    )

  if (
    anyDuplicated(
      colnames(
        counts
      )
    )
  ) {
    warning(
      dataset_name,
      ": duplicated sample IDs after barcode shortening; keeping first."
    )

    counts <- counts[
      ,
      !duplicated(
        colnames(
          counts
        )
      ),
      drop =
        FALSE
    ]
  }

  counts
}


read_clinical <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name
) {
  assert_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file"
    )
  )

  clinical <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE,
    fileEncoding =
      "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c(
      "NA",
      ""
    ),
    check.names =
      FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    params$
      sample_column,

    params$
      group_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(
      clinical
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing_columns
    ) >
      0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file is missing: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  clinical[[
    params$
      sample_column
  ]] <-
    normalize_tcga_id(
      clinical[[
        params$
          sample_column
      ]]
    )

  clinical[[
    params$
      group_column
  ]] <-
    factor(
      clinical[[
        params$
          group_column
      ]],
      levels =
        group_levels
    )

  clinical <- clinical %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        .data[[
          params$
            group_column
        ]]
      )
    )

  clinical <- clinical[
    !duplicated(
      clinical[[
        params$
          sample_column
      ]]
    ),
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  rownames(
    clinical
  ) <-
    clinical[[
      params$
        sample_column
    ]]

  clinical
}
```

```{r}
prepare_dataset <- function(
    dataset_name,
    counts,
    clinical
) {
  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(
      counts
    ),
    rownames(
      clinical
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      common_samples
    ) <
      5
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": fewer than five matched samples."
    )
  }

  counts <- counts[
    ,
    common_samples,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  clinical <- clinical[
    common_samples,
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(
        counts
      ),
      rownames(
        clinical
      )
    )
  )

  group <- droplevels(
    clinical[[
      params$
        group_column
    ]]
  )

  message(
    "\n",
    dataset_name,
    "\nMatched samples: ",
    ncol(
      counts
    ),
    "\nMSI/TMB group sizes:"
  )

  print(
    table(
      group
    )
  )

  
  
  
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts =
      counts,
    group =
      group
  )

  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(
    y,
    group =
      group,
    min.count =
      params$
        min_count
  )

  y <- y[
    keep,
    ,
    keep.lib.sizes =
      FALSE
  ]

  
  
  
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(
    y,
    method =
      "TMM"
  )

  logcpm_all <- edgeR::cpm(
    y,
    log =
      TRUE,
    prior.count =
      params$
        logcpm_prior_count
  )

  
  
  
  gene_variance <- apply(
    logcpm_all,
    1,
    stats::var,
    na.rm =
      TRUE
  )

  gene_mean <- rowMeans(
    logcpm_all,
    na.rm =
      TRUE
  )

  variance_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Gene =
      rownames(
        logcpm_all
      ),

    Mean_logCPM =
      as.numeric(
        gene_mean
      ),

    Variance =
      as.numeric(
        gene_variance
      )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(
        Variance
      ),
      Variance >
        0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        Variance
      ),
      Gene
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Variance_rank =
        dplyr::row_number(),

      Selected_HVG =
        Variance_rank <=
        params$
          top_variable_genes
    )

  selected_genes <- variance_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Selected_HVG
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      Gene
    )

  hvg_expression <- logcpm_all[
    selected_genes,
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  message(
    dataset_name,
    ": ",
    nrow(
      logcpm_all
    ),
    " genes retained after low-expression filtering."
  )

  message(
    dataset_name,
    ": top ",
    nrow(
      hvg_expression
    ),
    " variable genes selected for PCA/t-SNE/UMAP."
  )

  list(
    dataset =
      dataset_name,

    clinical =
      clinical,

    dge =
      y,

    logcpm_all =
      logcpm_all,

    variance_table =
      variance_table,

    selected_genes =
      selected_genes,

    expression =
      hvg_expression
  )
}
```

```{r}
run_embeddings <- function(
    prepared
) {
  dataset_name <-
    prepared$
      dataset

  expression <-
    prepared$
      expression

  clinical <-
    prepared$
      clinical

  
  
  
  pca <- stats::prcomp(
    t(
      expression
    ),
    center =
      TRUE,
    scale. =
      FALSE
  )

  variance_fraction <-
    pca$
      sdev^2 /
    sum(
      pca$
        sdev^2
    )

  variance_percent <-
    100 *
    variance_fraction

  cumulative_variance <-
    cumsum(
      variance_fraction
    )

  
  
  
  n_pc_by_variance <- which(
    cumulative_variance >=
      params$
        embedding_variance_threshold
  )[1]

  if (
    is.na(
      n_pc_by_variance
    )
  ) {
    n_pc_by_variance <-
      length(
        cumulative_variance
      )
  }

  n_embedding_pcs <- min(
    params$
      embedding_max_pcs,

    n_pc_by_variance,

    ncol(
      pca$
        x
    ),

    nrow(
      pca$
        x
    ) -
      1
  )

  n_embedding_pcs <- max(
    2,
    n_embedding_pcs
  )

  embedding_input <- pca$
    x[
      ,
      seq_len(
        n_embedding_pcs
      ),
      drop =
        FALSE
    ]

  message(
    dataset_name,
    ": t-SNE/UMAP use ",
    n_embedding_pcs,
    " PCs explaining ",
    round(
      100 *
        cumulative_variance[
          n_embedding_pcs
        ],
      1
    ),
    "% of HVG expression variance."
  )

  
  
  
  n_samples <- nrow(
    embedding_input
  )

  max_valid_perplexity <- floor(
    (
      n_samples -
        2
    ) /
      3
  )

  tsne_perplexity <- min(
    params$
      tsne_max_perplexity,
    max_valid_perplexity
  )

  tsne_perplexity <- max(
    1,
    tsne_perplexity
  )

  if (
    3 *
      tsne_perplexity >=
      n_samples -
      1
  ) {
    tsne_perplexity <- max(
      1,
      floor(
        (
          n_samples -
            2
        ) /
          3
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    tsne_perplexity <
      1
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": too few samples for t-SNE."
    )
  }

  seed_offset <- match(
    dataset_name,
    c(
      "COAD",
      "READ",
      "UCEC"
    )
  )

  set.seed(
    params$
      random_seed +
      seed_offset
  )

  tsne <- Rtsne::Rtsne(
    embedding_input,
    dims =
      2,
    perplexity =
      tsne_perplexity,
    theta =
      params$
        tsne_theta,
    max_iter =
      params$
        tsne_max_iter,
    pca =
      FALSE,
    check_duplicates =
      FALSE,
    verbose =
      TRUE
  )

  
  
  
  umap_neighbors <- min(
    params$
      umap_n_neighbors,
    n_samples -
      1
  )

  umap_neighbors <- max(
    2,
    umap_neighbors
  )

  set.seed(
    params$
      random_seed +
      100 +
      seed_offset
  )

  umap <- uwot::umap(
    embedding_input,
    n_neighbors =
      umap_neighbors,
    n_components =
      2,
    min_dist =
      params$
        umap_min_dist,
    metric =
      params$
        umap_metric,
    n_threads =
      1,
    verbose =
      TRUE
  )

  
  
  
  sample_ids <- rownames(
    pca$
      x
  )

  metadata <- clinical[
    sample_ids,
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  pca_scores <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_submitter_id =
      sample_ids,

    Dim1 =
      pca$
        x[
          ,
          1
        ],

    Dim2 =
      pca$
        x[
          ,
          2
        ],

    MSI_TMB =
      metadata[[
        params$
          group_column
      ]]
  )

  tsne_scores <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_submitter_id =
      sample_ids,

    Dim1 =
      tsne$
        Y[
          ,
          1
        ],

    Dim2 =
      tsne$
        Y[
          ,
          2
        ],

    MSI_TMB =
      metadata[[
        params$
          group_column
      ]]
  )

  umap_scores <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_submitter_id =
      sample_ids,

    Dim1 =
      umap[
        ,
        1
      ],

    Dim2 =
      umap[
        ,
        2
      ],

    MSI_TMB =
      metadata[[
        params$
          group_column
      ]]
  )

  variance_explained_table <- tibble::tibble(
    PC =
      paste0(
        "PC",
        seq_along(
          variance_percent
        )
      ),

    Variance_percent =
      variance_percent,

    Cumulative_variance_percent =
      100 *
      cumulative_variance
  )

  parameter_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Dataset =
      dataset_name,

    Samples =
      n_samples,

    Genes_after_filterByExpr =
      nrow(
        prepared$
          logcpm_all
      ),

    HVGs_used =
      nrow(
        expression
      ),

    Embedding_PCs =
      n_embedding_pcs,

    Embedding_PC_variance_percent =
      100 *
      cumulative_variance[
        n_embedding_pcs
      ],

    tSNE_perplexity =
      tsne_perplexity,

    UMAP_n_neighbors =
      umap_neighbors
  )

  list(
    dataset =
      dataset_name,

    pca =
      pca,

    pca_scores =
      pca_scores,

    tsne_scores =
      tsne_scores,

    umap_scores =
      umap_scores,

    variance_percent =
      variance_percent,

    variance_table =
      variance_explained_table,

    parameter_table =
      parameter_table
  )
}
```

```{r}
base_embedding_plot <- function(
    scores,
    title,
    x_label,
    y_label
) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    scores,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        Dim1,

      y =
        Dim2,

      color =
        MSI_TMB
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      size =
        params$
          point_size,
      alpha =
        params$
          point_alpha
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values =
        group_colors,
      breaks =
        group_levels,
      drop =
        FALSE,
      name =
        NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        title,
      x =
        x_label,
      y =
        y_label
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size =
        12
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "bold",
          hjust =
            0.5
        ),

      legend.position =
        "bottom"
    )
}


plot_pca <- function(
    result
) {
  p <- base_embedding_plot(
    scores =
      result$
        pca_scores,

    title =
      paste0(
        result$
          dataset,
        " — PCA (top ",
        params$
          top_variable_genes,
        " variable genes)"
      ),

    x_label =
      paste0(
        "PC1 (",
        round(
          result$
            variance_percent[
              1
            ],
          1
        ),
        "%)"
      ),

    y_label =
      paste0(
        "PC2 (",
        round(
          result$
            variance_percent[
              2
            ],
          1
        ),
        "%)"
      )
  )

  if (
    isTRUE(
      params$
        show_pca_centroids
    )
  ) {
    centroids <- result$
      pca_scores %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        MSI_TMB
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Dim1 =
          mean(
            Dim1,
            na.rm =
              TRUE
          ),

        Dim2 =
          mean(
            Dim2,
            na.rm =
              TRUE
          ),

        .groups =
          "drop"
      )

    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data =
          centroids,
        ggplot2::aes(
          x =
            Dim1,
          y =
            Dim2,
          color =
            MSI_TMB
        ),
        inherit.aes =
          FALSE,
        shape =
          4,
        size =
          5,
        stroke =
          1.5,
        show.legend =
          FALSE
      ) +

      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data =
          centroids,
        ggplot2::aes(
          x =
            Dim1,
          y =
            Dim2,
          label =
            MSI_TMB,
          color =
            MSI_TMB
        ),
        inherit.aes =
          FALSE,
        size =
          3.2,
        fontface =
          "bold",
        box.padding =
          0.30,
        point.padding =
          0.20,
        show.legend =
          FALSE
      )
  }

  p
}
```

```{r}
prepared_data <- list()
embedding_results <- list()
plot_results <- list()

for (
  dataset_name in names(
    dataset_inputs
  )
) {
  prepared_data[[
    dataset_name
  ]] <- prepare_dataset(
    dataset_name =
      dataset_name,

    counts =
      dataset_inputs[[
        dataset_name
      ]]$
        counts,

    clinical =
      dataset_inputs[[
        dataset_name
      ]]$
        clinical
  )

  embedding_results[[
    dataset_name
  ]] <- run_embeddings(
    prepared_data[[
      dataset_name
    ]]
  )

  plot_results[[
    dataset_name
  ]] <- list(
    PCA =
      plot_pca(
        embedding_results[[
          dataset_name
        ]]
      ),

    tSNE =
      plot_tsne(
        embedding_results[[
          dataset_name
        ]]
      ),

    UMAP =
      plot_umap(
        embedding_results[[
          dataset_name
        ]]
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
workbook_tables <- list(
  Group_sizes =
    group_sizes,

  Embedding_parameters =
    embedding_parameters
)

for (
  dataset_name in names(
    embedding_results
  )
) {
  workbook_tables[[
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_PCA"
    )
  ]] <-
    embedding_results[[
      dataset_name
    ]]$
      pca_scores

  workbook_tables[[
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_tSNE"
    )
  ]] <-
    embedding_results[[
      dataset_name
    ]]$
      tsne_scores

  workbook_tables[[
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_UMAP"
    )
  ]] <-
    embedding_results[[
      dataset_name
    ]]$
      umap_scores

  workbook_tables[[
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_PCAvar"
    )
  ]] <-
    embedding_results[[
      dataset_name
    ]]$
      variance_table

  workbook_tables[[
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_HVG"
    )
  ]] <-
    prepared_data[[
      dataset_name
    ]]$
      variance_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Selected_HVG
      )
}


openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  workbook_tables,
  file =
    file.path(
      params$output_root,
      "COAD_READ_UCEC_HVG_global_expression_embeddings.xlsx"
    ),
  overwrite =
    TRUE
)
```
